actions.title: Publish the canonical target registry
actions.counterProof: Duplicate one source repository across two targets; validation must fail.
actions.rollback: Revert the registry commit; no repository mutation is performed.

actions.title: Activate consolidation freeze and stop-the-line limits
actions.counterProof: Set autoClose or disable human approval for archive; validation must fail.
actions.rollback: Human-approved freeze update only; no automatic unfreeze.

actions.title: Generate live repository and pull-request triage evidence
actions.counterProof: Remove one registered repository from the live response; strict mode must stop the line.
actions.rollback: Disable the read-only scheduled workflow; generated reports are disposable.

actions.title: Use automation-control-plane as the prepared AgentOps base
actions.verification: Review draft PR 4, head cc89dce628202c0ec590567fc7f41ad9637a8012, CI run 32091685544, source SHA inventory, collision report, compatibility contract, installed artifact parity, and 102-test counter-proof suite.
actions.counterProof: Demonstrate a required AgentOps invariant that the selected base cannot implement without weakening safety.
actions.rollback: Change selectedBase in the registry before imports; no new repository is created.

actions.title: Resolve the three Shipcheck identities
actions.verification: One canonical package/CLI plus tested compatibility aliases and migration documentation.
actions.counterProof: Change README branding without changing package and CLI; the identity check must fail.
actions.rollback: Keep existing repositories active and unarchived until the target release is verified.

actions.title: Enforce archive gates and human approval
actions.verification: Counter-proof tests reject ARCHIVED unless release, compatibility, consumers, redirect, rollback, and human gates pass.
actions.counterProof: Mark a source ARCHIVED while one gate is BLOCKED; validation must fail.
actions.rollback: Revert state to ACTIVE_SOURCE or ROLLED_BACK; repository settings remain unchanged.

actions.title: Cap active consolidation review at two targets
actions.verification: Live snapshot fails strict mode when active consolidation count exceeds the policy limit.
actions.counterProof: Inject a third active consolidation PR into the synthetic snapshot; stop-the-line must trigger.
actions.rollback: Adjust the limit only by reviewed policy change.

actions.title: Make runner and runtime support explicit
actions.verification: Reusable workflows use explicit runner images and documented runtime matrices.
actions.counterProof: Replace the runner with a mutable alias; governance validation must fail.
actions.rollback: Revert workflow change; consumers stay pinned to an earlier SHA.

actions.title: Add installed artifact smoke and sdist/wheel parity checks
actions.verification: Install each built format in a clean environment and execute help/version/minimal scenario.
actions.counterProof: Remove the console entry point from one artifact; the smoke test must fail.
actions.rollback: Consumers retain the previous reusable workflow SHA.

actions.title: Add release SBOM, provenance, and trusted publishing policy
actions.verification: A release candidate contains SBOM, provenance, digest, protected environment, and post-publication verification.
actions.counterProof: Delete one attestation from the candidate; release gate must become BLOCKED.
actions.rollback: Do not publish; retain the previous release.

actions.title: Generate one evidence-first public dashboard from the registry
actions.verification: Dashboard values are generated from the exact registry/live snapshot SHA and expire with its TTL.
actions.counterProof: Change a displayed status without changing the source snapshot; the build must fail.
actions.rollback: Keep the existing profile entry point until the generated site is verified.

actions.title: Inventory consumers before any redirect or archive
actions.verification: Scan imports, packages, workflows, links, documentation, dependants, and examples.
actions.counterProof: Add a synthetic consumer after inventory; the archive gate must return BLOCKED.
actions.rollback: Restore source support and reverse redirects when a missed consumer appears.

actions.title: Separate release preparation from published release
actions.verification: Tag, release, artifacts, smoke, changelog, and post-publication checks all point to one commit.
actions.counterProof: Remove the tag or artifact; the status must fall back to PREPARED.
actions.rollback: Delete an unpublished candidate tag only after review; do not claim release.

actions.title: Complete professional profile metadata and topics
actions.verification: Profile metadata, homepage, pinned targets, and repository topics match verified target state.
actions.counterProof: Point the profile to an unreleased target; profile validation must fail.
actions.rollback: Restore previous profile metadata and pinned repositories.
